title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation), consolidated version of 4.5.2016 ("000.002"), which applies the corrigendum of 23.5.2018
fetch: HTTP GET with Accept: application/xhtml+xml and Accept-Language: eng, User-Agent legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons), following redirects (curl -L); the resource answered 200 at the cellar URL above
role: reading aid: the Publications Office consolidated version, which says of itself that it is meant purely as a documentation tool and has no legal effect; the Official Journal text is authentic. Recitals are not part of it. Its header lists one correction, the corrigendum OJ L 127, 23.5.2018, p. 2, marked `►C1` ... `◄` in the text. The `▼B` and `▼C1` markers of the consolidated version are kept in the text file, one per line. It is the text this subject quotes for Articles 1-99.
in_force: the version dated 4.5.2016; its header lists no amending act, only the 2018 corrigendum. Later dated consolidations were not enumerated: the consolidated CELEX numbers with dates 2018-05-23, 2021-03-04 and 2026-01-01 answered 404 on 2026-11-26, which is a probe and not an enumeration.
sha256_of: the XHTML original as fetched (462,324 bytes); not re-deposited here (licence undetermined, as for the other XHTML originals under subjects/eu/)
rendered_by: xhtml_to_text.py in this folder (a byte-for-byte copy of the one in subjects/eu/ai-act-2024/registers/source-bundle/; standard library only; run as python3 -I xhtml_to_text.py IN.xhtml OUT.txt): one block per line, a list label joined to its text, a footnote reference as [^N], an exponent as ^N, table rows as | a | b |, amendment markers as their own lines
checked: Every text node of 12 or more characters of the XHTML was looked up in the rendering on 2026-11-26: 927 nodes, 4 not found: the file's title line, and three footnote texts that the XHTML starts with a stray ")" (the footnote texts themselves are in the rendering). Each of the 15 corrections of the corrigendum was looked up: for 14 the "for" wording is in the as-published text and the "read" wording is in this text (the match for Article 65(1)(a) was made by eye because the corrigendum quotes it with an ellipsis); recital 71 is not in this text, which has no recitals.
